claimChecks.version: 10.6 guides; documented source and signed-package floors
claimChecks.environment: Customer-managed Linux and Windows; Cloud-facing deployments
claimChecks.assessment: The guide’s comparison models upgrade steps, OS and receivers, but has no fleet-upgrade management evidence. Enterprise Agent Management distributes content. The separate host-installed Remote Upgrader installs UF packages through documented deployment-server workflows. Both 10.6 guides list UF 9.0+ and name 8.0 as the oldest source, with x509-signed packages available from 9.0.0. Linux retains package format and requires root/sudo to install the upgrader. Windows lists only the named 64-bit Server editions and requires Local System or Local Admin for MSI. The Cloud deployment server stays customer-managed. These facts establish neither a Cloud-native upgrader nor eligibility for a particular UF OS or version route.
